scope: core module (app/) only; extension apps appear only as out-of-scope XCTL targets

program_edges.resolution: JCL written to TDQ JOBS (internal reader)

menus_reach_all_online.claim: COMEN01C/COADM01C XCTL to every online program
menus_reach_all_online.detail: COMEN01C -> 12 programs via COMEN02Y, COADM01C -> 7 via COADM02Y; together they reach 15/17 core online programs. Not reached: COADM01C, COMEN01C (the sign-on program XCTLs *to* the menus, and sub-screens COCRDSLC/COCRDUPC, COTRN01C, COUSR02C/COUSR03C are also reached from their list screens). Menu tables also name COPAUS0C, COTRTLIC, COTRTUPC, which are not core programs (extension apps, out of scope).

csutldtc_callers.detail: 2 direct callers (CORPT00C, COTRN02C) + 1 through copybook procedure code (COACTUPC via CSUTLDPY) = 3 calling programs, not 4.

cbact01c_asm.detail: CBACT01C calls COBDATFT (and CEE3ABD) only; MVSWAIT is called by COBSWAIT (WAITSTEP job), not by CBACT01C.

cee3abd_sites.detail: CALL 'CEE3ABD' appears once in each of 11 batch programs: CBACT01C, CBACT02C, CBACT03C, CBACT04C, CBCUS01C, CBEXPORT, CBIMPORT, CBSTM03A, CBTRN01C, CBTRN02C, CBTRN03C

no_cics_start.detail: No program issues EXEC CICS START; the only asynchronous hand-off is CORPT00C writing TRANREPT JCL to TDQ JOBS.

rating_criteria.points: each criterion scores 0-3; total 0-15; Low <= 4, Medium 5-8, High >= 9; a program containing ALTER is raised one level (ALTER has no Java equivalent and forces a control-flow rewrite)
rating_criteria.files: distinct datasets touched (batch SELECT/ASSIGN + CICS FILE via CSD): >=1 ->1, >=3 ->2, >=5 ->3
rating_criteria.control_flow: GO TO + ALTER count: >=1 ->1, >=10 ->2, >=30 ->3; +1 if any ALTER; +1 if EVALUATE nests >= 2 deep (capped at 3)
rating_criteria.arithmetic: COMP-3 fields (own + via copybooks) + ROUNDED + COMPUTE statements: >=1 ->1, >=6 ->2, >=15 ->3
rating_criteria.coupling: fan-in + fan-out over program/assembler edges (CALL, XCTL, LINK, resolved dynamic targets): >=1 ->1, >=3 ->2, >=6 ->3

migration_order.title: Data-only utilities and plumbing (no business logic)
migration_order.rationale: Dataset definitions, loads, backups and operator jobs translate to schema/DDL, seed loaders and Spring Batch infrastructure; they have no COBOL business rules and unblock every later phase.

steps.note: Timer utility (COBSWAIT -> MVSWAIT STIMER); becomes a scheduler delay, no port needed.
Pure date-validation subprogram shared by CORPT00C, COTRN02C and COACTUPC (via CSUTLDPY); port first as a java.time utility so online phases reuse it.
IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER/AIX/GDG and CSD upload: become Flyway DDL + table/sequence definitions.
File loads (REPRO PS -> VSAM): become seed-data loaders for the golden set; needed before any batch or online program can be verified.

CICS file open/close, GDG backups, prints and transfer jobs: become batch job steps/ops scripts with no COBOL to translate (COMBTRAN is also COBOL-free but reads INTCALC's SYSTRAN(+1), so it sits in B3).

migration_order.title: Batch jobs in JCL/dataset dependency order
migration_order.rationale: Order follows the dataset lineage in section 4: each job only reads datasets written by jobs earlier in the list (POSTTRAN updates ACCTFILE/TCATBALF that INTCALC reads; INTCALC writes SYSTRAN(+1) that COMBTRAN merges back; TRANREPT and CREASTMT read the posted TRANSACT file).

steps.note: Read-only file dump programs: lowest risk, exercise the VSAM -> JPA repositories and the COBDATFT date formatter.

Daily transaction posting (validation + account/category balance update, rejects to DALYREJS(+1)). CBTRN01C is the earlier validation-only variant with no JCL; port alongside as the validation module.

Interest calculation over TCATBALF/DISCGRP, writes SYSTRAN(+1) and updates ACCTFILE; depends on POSTTRAN output. COMBTRAN (SORT merge of TRANSACT.BKUP(0) + SYSTRAN(0) -> TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1) -> REPRO into TRANSACT) must follow INTCALC, as in the Control-M MONTHLY-InterestCalculation folder.
Reporting: TRANREPT (REPROC backup -> SORT -> CBTRN03C report GDG) and CREASTMT (SORT -> REPRO -> CBSTM03A/B statements). CBSTM03A/B carry the GO TO/ALTER logic and are the hardest batch port.
Branch migration export/import; independent of the daily chain, last because they are operational tooling.

migration_order.title: Online programs from leaf screens to menus
migration_order.rationale: Leaf screens have no forward XCTL (they only return to the menu/sign-on), so each can be verified in isolation against its BMS map; list screens that XCTL into detail/update screens follow; menus and sign-on last because they depend on every target existing.

steps.note: Leaf screens, ordered by complexity score (lowest first).

List screens that transfer to detail/update screens (COUSR00C -> COUSR02C, COUSR03C; COCRDLIC -> COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC; COTRN01C -> COTRN00C; COTRN00C -> COTRN01C). Mutual transfers (COTRN00C <-> COTRN01C) are ported as a pair.
Sign-on / entry transaction CC00 (USRSEC read, XCTL to the two menus); last so the full navigation path can be verified end to end.
